headline: 57 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Second Flat Fire in OR, threatening 832 structures.

active_threats.name: Second Flat
active_threats.narrative: The Second Flat Fire in Harney County, OR has burned 105,854 acres and is 99% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **832 structures threatened**. 6 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 29 mph, sustained near 17) with humidity as low as 24%. A wind shift is expected during the window — the kind of transition that is hardest for a 3 km forecast model to time and place precisely. Forecast wind (N) is not currently aligned toward Hines city, the nearest community of size, 18 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over NV: Reno city, Carson City, Fernley city, Spanish Springs CDP, and Dayton CDP and 10 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch and SPC's **Elevated** fire-weather category and NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (day 1). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 12% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
